name: Stellar AI - Production Monitoring
description: World-class monitoring dashboard for Stellar Global Supplies AI

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) AS 'Apdex' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'Req/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT average(duration * 1000) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET transactionName SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET httpResponseCode SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET transactionName SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET transactionName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET error.class SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionType = 'Web' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'Count', latest(error.message) AS 'Latest Message', latest(transactionName) AS 'Endpoint', max(timestamp) AS 'Last Seen' FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago FACET error.class ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM DatastoreSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET datastoreType, table SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM DatastoreSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET operation SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM DatastoreSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET operation SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'DB Error %' FROM DatastoreSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms', max(duration * 1000) AS 'Max ms', count(*) AS 'Calls', latest(table) AS 'Table' FROM DatastoreSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 1 hour ago FACET statement ORDER BY average(duration) DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND host LIKE '%groq%' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND host LIKE '%brave%' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(duration * 1000) AS 'Avg ms' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND host LIKE '%hf.space%' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= '400') AS 'Error %' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET host SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: External API Call Volume by Service

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'Calls' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET host SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 95) AS 'P95 ms' FROM ExternalSegment WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND host LIKE '%groq%' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode = '200') AS 'Success %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/auth/login%' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS '429 Hits' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND httpResponseCode = '429' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS '401s' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND httpResponseCode = '401' SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT count(*) AS '403s' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND httpResponseCode = '403' SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT count(*) AS 'Total', filter(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode = '200') AS 'Success', filter(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode = '401') AS 'Failed' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/auth/login%' SINCE 1 hour ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) AS 'Hits' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND httpResponseCode = '429' FACET request.headers.x-forwarded-for SINCE 1 hour ago ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS 'Count', latest(error.message) AS 'Error', max(timestamp) AS 'Last Attempt' FROM TransactionError WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND transactionName LIKE '%/api/auth%' SINCE 1 hour ago FACET error.message ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT uniqueCount(session) AS 'Active Sessions' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'Msgs/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/chat%/send%' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'Searches/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/search%' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Images/hr' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/image%' SINCE 1 hour ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET cases(WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/chat%' AS 'Chat', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/search%' AS 'Web Search', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/image%' AS 'Image Gen', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/files%' AS 'File Upload', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/ent%' AS 'Ent Data') SINCE 2 hours ago TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' FACET cases(WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/chat%' AS 'Chat', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/search%' AS 'Web Search', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/image%' AS 'Image Gen', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/files%' AS 'File Upload', WHERE request.uri LIKE '%/api/ent%' AS 'Ent Data') SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Requests' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' AND request.uri LIKE '%/api/chat%' FACET request.parameters.model SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 10
SELECT latest(newrelic.timeslice.value) * 1000 AS 'Heap MB' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'Memory/Heap/Used' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 2 minutes ago
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Loop Lag ms' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'EventLoop/Lag/Current' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 2 minutes ago
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'GC ms' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName LIKE 'GC/%' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 5 minutes ago
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Connections' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'Agent/Connections/Current' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 2 minutes ago
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Heap Used MB' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'Memory/Heap/Used' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'Lag ms' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'EventLoop/Lag/Current' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(newrelic.timeslice.value) AS 'CPU %' FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName = 'CPU/User Time' AND appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'Tx/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 minutes ago TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode < '500') AS 'Availability %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT percentile(duration * 1000, 95) AS 'P95 ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT (0.1 - percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= '500')) AS 'Error Budget %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= '500') AS '5xx %', percentage(count(*), WHERE httpResponseCode >= '400' AND httpResponseCode < '500') AS '4xx %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES 1 hour
SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) AS 'Apdex' FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'stellar_ai' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES 1 hour
